faq.a: Magnolia Apartments is at 2701 W Manor Pl, Seattle, WA 98199 — in the heart of Seattle's Magnolia neighborhood, a short walk from Discovery Park and Magnolia Village.

faq.q: How much is rent, and what floor plans are available?
faq.a: We offer one-bedroom homes (about 600 sq ft) starting at $1,595/month and two-bedroom, two-bath homes (about 1,000 sq ft) up to $1,995/month. See current availability and floor plans for live pricing.

faq.q: Is there a move-in special right now?
faq.a: Yes — one month free on a 12-month lease for current move-ins. Specials can change, so confirm the latest offer when you schedule a tour.
Yes. The building has both covered and uncovered parking options on-site.
Yes, the community is pet-friendly. Contact the leasing office at (206) 694-1713 for the current pet policy, deposits, and any breed or weight guidelines.

faq.q: What are the rental application and screening requirements?
faq.a: Applicants are screened for a credit score of 650 or higher with minimal negative reporting, 1–2 years of positive rental history, and a combined household income of about 3× the monthly rent. Seattle applications are processed in accordance with the First-in-Time Ordinance (SMC 14.08).

faq.q: How close is Discovery Park, and what else is nearby?
faq.a: Discovery Park — 534 acres of trails, beaches, and a historic lighthouse — is just minutes away. You're also near Magnolia Village's shops, cafés, and weekend farmers market, with downtown Seattle a short drive away. Explore the neighborhood map for distances and travel times.

faq.q: How do I schedule a tour or apply?
faq.a: Use the tour scheduler on this page to pick a time, or call (206) 694-1713. Our leasing team will walk you through the application from there.
